avis.texte: I fall for these viral influencer skincare stuff all the time and every single time, I am disappointed because they never work even after using it for months... until I bought this. It is absolutely worth the hype and it 100% does work. I have never felt my nose and chin this smooth before, especially not without manual extraction (which was literally the ONLY thing that had worked in the 15+ years I've been dealing with sebaceous filaments). I used it after a shower and kept the cotton pad on problem areas for about 10 minutes, and then scraped with a ultrasonic pore scraper thingy (I did buy the Ilso branded scraper, but it shipped separately from the bottle so it hasn't arrived yet). The sebum comes off like hot butter. Just make sure to buy a large pack of thin cotton pads since I don't think the box that comes with the bottle is enough. I have nothing but good things to say about this. I avoided it for so long because I thought it was a gimmick, but it genuinely works. If AHA/BHA/oil cleansing/etc has never worked for you, try this out. It definitely needs regular use because sebaceous filaments always come back, but that's for all products that target them and this one works basically instantly so it's definitely worth it!!

avis.titre: This may have replaced pore strips for me
avis.texte: I want to mention that I am HIGHLY skeptical of most skincare products. Very few have actually made a difference I've found actually noticeable. I've recently developed persistent blackheads on a significant portion of my face - nose as usual, but cheeks, forehead, and chin also have also broken out badly. They're small but many, at the point where there's a noticeable texture that I really hate. I've tried SA cleansers, BHA toners, retinol, etc., but not seeing a difference. I finally actually followed the instructions for this stuff and let the saturated strips sit on my nose for a full 10-15 mins, then used a small face scraper to clean them off. Mind, this was AFTER I had used pore strips the day before and already pulled a decent few blackheads out. I'm SO sad I didn't take a picture of the aftermath on that scraper! It looked like I scraped putty off my skin - layer upon layer of visible, whole blackheads were sitting on it! I eventually used it on all my problem areas and had similar results! My skin isn't perfect - think this only removed 90% or so of the blackheads, so there's still quite a few left in there numerically - and I do think using this stuff twice in a row without giving your skin some time to rest will cause irritation. But my skin is so much smoother, and I feel confident that with consistent use alongside cleansing and moisturizing, I may actually have a solid fix!

avis.titre: Works so well it’s scaryWorks so well it’s scary
avis.texte: I lay the pad on my nose, soak it, wait 10 mins, and all the gunk and sebum comes right to the surface omg it’s kinda gross LOL but that means it’s working!!!!! It works so well and is so easy to use and clean up. After using this product, I double cleanse with Anua heartleaf oil cleanser and pore deep cleanser and my skin feels so squeaky clean and clear. If you wanna get the gunk out of your pores (all over your face, not just nose) then GET THISSSSS

This product is great! I’ve seen reviews saying that what comes off is just product rather than sebaceous filaments, but I can definitely tell this is actually doing what it’s intended to do. Of course, some product comes up too, but my skin feels noticeably smoother afterward. I wipe my skin with a wipe after removing the soaked strip and use this a couple of times a week, especially when I’ve been wearing foundation or sunscreen. Since using it regularly, I’ve noticed an improvement in my skin’s texture and a more glowing complexion. My makeup and skincare seem to apply and work better, and I’ve even noticed a more even-looking tan in the summer. Definitely worth trying if you want an easy treatment at home!
It doesn't work as well as I wish it could have... but it does the job.
It does its job, I use a face spatula to scrape the sebum off. Of course it always comes back but this takes care of it again and again

WOW! WOW! This product is amazing. This gunk was all on my nose. This is my first time trying the product. I let it sit for 15 min and used my scraper and look at what came out. I didn't try it after showering as most recommended, but I am certain it works better after steaming your face or showering to open up your pores. However, without having done that it still worked very well. A must product to add to your daily routine.

avis.titre: Where has this been and why is noone talking about it?!
avis.texte: Wow this works! You will need a blackhead extractor tool or scraper but this softens the sebum and blackheads and makes them so easy to extract. They practically flow out with minimal pressure. (Kinda gross I know) But as someone who has a lot of hardened sebum in my nose pores, this is it! My nose feels so soft and looks so much clearer the next morning its crazy. 100% recommend!
This stuff is incredible!! It really works and leaves your skin feeling so smooth and amazing! Even the next day I can’t stop touching my nose!

I’ve been using the product for a couple of months and I don’t see mayor changes, It does help to soften my face a bit but the black heads are still visible, I will keep trying it but not sure if I would buy it again. Not results I was expecting for the price of the product
半信半疑で悩んだ末に購入しました。結果、かなりツルツルになって、綺麗になったように思います。家族にも好評でしたので、リピートしたいと思っています。家族には、ややピリつきを感じた者がいたので、敏感肌さんは注意が必要かもしれません。

avis.titre: 酸化による黒ずみ毛穴にも良い
avis.texte: しっかり汚れを浮き上がらせてくれるので綺麗になり、毛穴の酸化による黒ずみも目立たなく為ってきました。使用後５日～７日に１度くらいの使用で毛穴も目立たなく為ってきました。 角栓の酸化も抑えられているのか、余り目立ちません。
Best for removing blackheads and sebum under the nose! I had the worst blackheads and they’re all gone after regular use
The box arrived in poor condition, but the product was fine. Next time, I would appreciate it if you could wrap it in bubble wrap.
I find this really unique. I have used it only two times now and I do feel like the sebum has really softened and that after a bit, my skin has been cleaner and smoother looking.

I have been looking for a way to clean my pores & I know this is yuck but - this photo is just from doing my nose- leave it on for like 10-15 mins, you will notice a change in the way your skin looks when it’s ready, white spots on top of the pores, then I used a black head popper & scraped it all out! I am very happy with this product!

I picked this up because James Welsh raves about it and it didn’t disappoint. I definitely noticed a fair amount of gunk coming out of my pores after letting this sit on my nose and chin (the areas that I have the most congestion) for 30 minutes! I wish it were fragrance free, but it didn’t irritate my skin, which was a pleasant surprise. I will definitely continue to use and purchase this product

I bought this after watching a video on TikTok where a girl gave clear instructions on how to use it. And gotta say hands down a great product! Does not irritate your skin at all but it does have a mild funky smell. I don’t even notice it anymore. I had to steam my face first for about 10 minutes and then applied this on my face and left it on for 10ish minutes. I rinsed it off with warm water and while still wet, I used a little suction machine for acne. That machine sucked out years of gunk after using this product! Definitely recommend it! Will be buying again. Zoom in on the picture and you’ll see everything that it brought to the surface!

avis.titre: Gets Rid of Gross T-Zone Congestion
avis.texte: I ordered this as while ago, and finally had the opportunity to use it a few times. What an awesome tool for dissolving sebum and blackheads. I have a lot of congestion in my t-zone and this is super helpful. This is so much better than Biore nose pore strips! This is great for getting rid of sebaceous filaments. I soak my face with very warm water washcloths to prep my skin first. It helps loosen up stuff. I was thinking of even trying steaming my skin first. I leave it on for almost 60 minutes to get rid of stubborn build-up. I highly recommend this stuff for frustrating congestion and blackheads. Just give it a few tries to work.
I’m not someone who leaves reviews, but I felt like I had to share this. I’m adding my before & after photos, look at the difference! I only used it once and the results were amazing.

avis.titre: Seems effective at removing blackheads and surface sebum and may be good for deeper cases over time.
avis.texte: I ordered the ILSO Super Melting Sebum Softener to treat a long-standing sebaceous cyst on my back. It’s not what the product is marketed for, but I wanted to avoid outpatient surgery and scarring, so I hoped the formula could help soften the buildup. After a few days of use, the cyst discharged some material, which I had to clean and monitor. It became slightly smaller afterward. Continued use hasn’t led to major changes yet, but I believe the deeper parts of the cyst are more established and may need more time and treatment to respond. The product is gentle and didn’t cause irritation, even on sensitive skin. It seems to work gradually, loosening hardened sebum layer by layer. The included cotton pads are usable, though I switched to cotton balls for better coverage. While this isn’t a medical solution, it did help with surface-level congestion and may continue to help over time. Based on my experience, I believe it would be effective for more typical surface sebum issues like blackheads or oily buildup.

Now that I am older, I no longer experience pimple breakouts. However, blackheads and whiteheads are still around my nose. I have tried several methods to deal with it, but none have been particularly effective. The ones that work better are the sticky pads that I wet, then put on my nose and leave to dry. I came across a K-Beauty cosmetic product that claims to melt sebum for easier extraction, so I ordered the ILSO Super Melting Sebum Softener to try. This product works a bit like sticky pads, but instead of pulling out the sebum, it says it softens and melts it so blackheads and whiteheads come out more easily. When I tried it, I did find it easier to remove them. I think using a scraper tool would help even more. Ilso sells a Deep Clean Master tool that I want to try, since using just a cotton swab is pretty tough.

avis.titre: I Don't Say this Lightly: I Wish I Could Give it More Stars
avis.texte: I am a beauty and skincare enthusiast, and have been using various skincare products for over 20 years. As such, I've tried a LOT, come up against ridiculous marketing hype and claims a lot. Few products surprise me anymore. This is one of them. I am absolutely blown away by this. Even understanding the positioning of the product - what it aims and claims to do - I was skeptical because that's my default mode. To say this exceeded expectations is an understatement. This kit comes with a bottle of product and 40 pads. You saturate the pad with the solution and set it where you'd like it to work - for me, I did my nose because I have a high concentration of sebacious filaments there that I manage - and leave it for 10 minutes. It has a slight medicinal smell, but isn't gross or anything. You don't have to use their pads - you could use any thin cotton or cotton-like solution. The brand also offers a scraper tool, which this kit doesn't include, but says you can use cotton swabs instead. I used a metal extraction tool to gently glide across my skin to remove the dissolved sebum. I was stunned by how much it removed, especially since I have a pretty decent system for managing it these days after years of trial and error. I'm also delighted to have no redness or irritation from using this. My the skin on and around my nose, which looked decent before, looks incredible. Feels incredible. I don't know how they've done it but I'm dying to find out. I don't expect to find many more ho

avis.titre: A new approach to blemish care.
avis.texte: This is a Korean skincare kit that is designed to treat blackheads (pimples). Since I am well past the age where that issue is a nuisance, I don't believe this product is aimed at my age demographic. The very Korean looking package I received contains the liquid treatment serum and a small package of what appears to be thin cotton treatment pads. The English language instructions are straightforward and easy to follow. Since I do have oily skin though as sort of a lasting reminder of my teenage, acne plagued years, I decided to "try it out" anyway, applying the liquid to one of the cotton pads and placed it on my nose for a few minutes. The clear, water liquid feels like it's doing something, perhaps the alkaline liquid is counteracting the oil sebum on my nose. It doesn't quite burn but it does feel like you are getting a bit of a skin treatment. My skin was definitely very "oil free" when I washed it off and ready for the rest of my usual skincare routine. If my skin felt particularly oily this seems like an effective method to temporarily counteract the oil. Of course it will be a temporary treatment since oil always comes back eventually. I'll keep this kit around and experiment with it again. My rating only reflects the apparent quality of the components in this set, not the actual effectiveness this system may or may not have on the treatment of blemishes.

I try to get facials every four months or so, sometimes a bit longer, because I tend to get a lot of blackheads around my nose and cheeks. I was excited to try this serum as a potential at-home solution. The set comes with the serum and cotton wraps, and the instructions are straightforward. It works similarly to traditional blackhead masks. The serum itself is a clear liquid. I applied it generously to a cotton pad until it was fully saturated, then placed the pad on my nose. Once the mask dried, I slowly removed it. For excess sebum, the instructions suggest using a metal spatula, but since I don’t have one, I gently rubbed with a cotton round to see if that would help. It didn't really do much. I found that the serum works effectively to remove blackheads, though it does involve a few extra steps compared to other serums I’ve used. It’s a good option if you’re looking for a more hands-on approach to at-home blackhead removal.

avis.titre: Effective treatment to clear your pores
avis.texte: This melting sebum softener is a pretty cool product. You apply it and leave it on for about 10 minutes, and it really does a good job at dissolving blackheads and clearing out pores. Afterwards, my skin looked noticeably smoother and my pores looked amazing. I like that it did not feel drying or harsh, and it washed off easily without leaving any residue. It feels gentle enough to use as a weekly treatment, yet effective enough that I actually see results. Definitely a great addition to a skincare routine if you are dealing with clogged pores or want a deeper clean than a regular cleanser provides.

avis.titre: Super easy to use and my skin feels amazing!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product! It comes with 40 “skin wrap” cotton pads, which makes it so convenient – no cutting or adjusting needed. The liquid is light and soothing, and it really melts away oil and helps remove blackheads, especially on the nose and chin. My skin feels so much cleaner, softer, and smooth after using it. The scent is very mild, not overpowering at all, and using it is super simple , just soak a pad, swipe over oily areas, and you’re done. I’ve been using it for a few days, and my skin hasn’t felt irritated at all. It’s perfect for quick daily cleansing and really helps control oil while keeping my skin fresh and clear. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Definitely deserves all the viral hype
avis.texte: This product definitely deserves its viral status and isn’t a gimmick at all. I love that it comes with little cotton pads that are easy to rip or cut into the perfect size. You soak the cotton in the liquid and let it sit for about 20 min then use either a silicone porre “scraper” tool or a q-tip and gently go along your skin and you will get so much sebum and pore gunk out. My skin felt soooooooo clean and refreshed afterwards. I take really good care of my skin and exfoliate regularly, do lots of face masks, a full skincare routine 2x a day, etc and I STILL got stuff out of my pores. It also didn’t irritate or dry out my skin afterwards or cause any peeling. I’ve already recommended this product to several people — it’s fantastic!!

avis.titre: not a fad, more like way fab
avis.texte: I don't use any social media sites so I did not know of the product until I saw this listing. I was a bit hesitant after the fact and dismissed it initially as just another trendy product that would be a quick fad. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that not only is it effective, it doesn't irritate the skin and doesn't act harshly on the skin like those Biore nose strips. This product doesn't pull out the sebum but melt it which prevents damage that might have occurred with the strips. Many, many people deal with the clogged pore look and this is something many people will get good usage out of. I plan on recommending this to family and friends. I would not do that unless I felt strongly about the product which I do.

avis.titre: Gentle way to remove blackhead without squeezing
avis.texte: This is such a useful set for gently removing blackheads on the nose or really anywhere on the face. I like that the kit includes the dry pads with the solution. The pads are like little mask once the solution is applied which can placed anywhere on the face to remove blackhead. Once 10 to 15 minutes is up, the pads can be removed. I find that this way of removing blackheads feel more gentle and less harsh on the skin than squeezing them out. The solution doesn’t sting and is scent free, too.

In my opinion, this product makes the skincare routine easier and less harsh. It softens and helps remove buildup without the usual pulling or squeezing, which feels much kinder to the skin. For me, it’s a refreshing option that leaves the face cleaner and more comfortable after use.

Wow, this is a really different product than anything I've used before, but it actually works great! Instead of trying to remove hard crap out of your pores, it softens it & makes it so much easier to remove, leaving your pores looking so clean & fresh, with no skin irritation. It's quite easy to use & after seeing the results, it is definitely a great value for your money. I strongly recommend giving it a try!

avis.titre: viral product that actually works well on me
avis.texte: this is a good find, really. usually I would not fall easily for “viral” products, but since I have trouble with black/whiteheads on my nose, I decided to give this one a try. it works like magic! easy to use and satisfying. my nose feel smoother now. I applied it for my husband as well, he likes the result but feel uneasy with the way I scrapped the gunk lol. but be sure to rinse with cold water afterwards and dont forget to continue with your usual skincare! but having this doesn’t mean you won’t need exfoliating toner anymore—cause, trust me, you will need those still on different parts of your face.

This is actually insane, I have lots of blackheads and this cleared it out really well. I used a little scraper tool to gently pass it over and it took everything out without irritating my skin!! The picture is kind of nasty but
This cleaned out my pores very well. My skin gets easily irritated; however, this product did cause any issues for me.

avis.titre: Easy to use and great product!
avis.texte: Great product! Has a bit of a strong smell but nothing unbearable. Seriously softens up those sebaceous filaments on the nose and makes its super easy to scoop all the gunk out.
So far I love it and you would be shocked how much comes off once you use the scrapper. If you struggle with pores buy this! 5-7 mins will change your skin care routine!
works OK for extracting some gunk (with the scraper), however this packaging looks like it was previously opened (and possibly used). sad!

I really wanted to like this product. I used it and I have no idea how other people don’t feel like their skin is irritated after scraping off the sebum with the remover. It literally made my nose peel and it stings.
The product arrived unsealed, as if it had been used, and the box was torn with tape used to seal it.
